decisions.reason: The book-access action does not change the NFT cover sizing or visibility rules; the source's separate cover-size verification is already represented.
Adding an owner-visible View Book action on the NFT detail page does not change any NFT metadata attributes.
The NFT detail book-access action does not affect the token standard, marketplace policy, or secondary-sale royalty.
The detail-page access action leaves the unlimited-mint NFT ebook collection model unchanged.
Showing the action to the current NFT owner is consistent with the existing transfer of book entitlement and does not modify resale-state transfer behavior.
The owner-only View Book action does not change which successfully minted NFTs the dashboard must display or count.
The source decision about the NFT detail View Book action does not require any change to the current FAQ content.
The NFT detail book-access action does not affect referral-code identity, sharing, display, permanence, or resale behavior.
The action applies to the NFT detail page and does not change the landing-page cover's placement, size, crop, or visibility.
The NFT detail action does not replace or modify the certificate email's existing read button, download link, or contents.
The owner-visible View Book action on the NFT detail page necessarily adds that page as an entry point to the ebook reader.

source_message.text:
1 - The invalid-code message looks great, but it needs one final wording change to: 'No/Invalid referral code! $5 + $500 prize draw ticket will go to an existing NFT holder at random'.

2 - The first mint continues not to work, possibly because the commission and ticket are coded to be awarded to an existing NFT holder, but no such holder exists for the first mint.

3 - The NFT size is good, and the 'View Book' button also looks good.

4 - The badges look good, but they are currently arranged with 5 in the top row and 3 in the bottom row. If possible, please make it 4 on the top row and 4 on the bottom row.
